subDescription.accessibilityText: 10 hours ago • Visible to anyone on or off LinkedIn

text.text:
I just hosted 350+ people at an OpenClaw Singapore meetup on a Wednesday night in Singapore.

OpenClaw Singapore x Alibaba Qwen x The AI Capitol took over Alibaba Cloud's space at Lazada One tonight and the confidence was absolutely electric.

Huge thank you to Alibaba Cloud and the Qwen team. This wasn't just a sponsorship. They opened their space, brought their Solutions Architects, and showed real commitment to the open source AI agent community in Southeast Asia. 

We had an incredible lineup of speakers tonight.

Kelvin Tan from Alibaba Cloud broke down Qwen's integration with OpenClaw, giving the room the technical foundation to build on.

Francis from Cloak Network introduced ATP, the trust layer for OpenClaw, sparking some of the most intense conversations of the evening.

Han from RoastMyTechStack gave his signature no nonsense take on rethinking your OpenClaw setup. Practical and honest.

Henry Mao from Smithery delivered "Give Your Agent Keys, Not the Kingdom" and had the whole room rethinking permission design for AI agents.

Marcus Liang from Formlabs blew minds showing where AI meets 3D printing, reminding us the agent revolution goes beyond software.

Steve from Flutterflow told the gripping story of how Maersk survived NotPetya. 300 people went dead silent for that one.

Chwan Ren Lee from AI Singapore closed out the talks showcasing OpenClaw running with SEA-LION. Homegrown Southeast Asian AI powering open source agents. A proud moment.

But honestly, the magic was in the networking. People weren't leaving. Builders debating architecture, founders exchanging contacts, strangers planning collaborations on the spot. That confidence is something you can't fake.

OpenClaw Singapore is now 2,500+ members strong and growing every week. What started as a small community of curious builders has become one of the most active OpenClaw communities in Southeast Asia and globally. 

To everyone who showed up tonight, you ARE the community. And we're just getting started.

Thank you so much.

#OpenClaw #AIAgents #Singapore #AlibabaQwen #TheAICapitol #AlibabaCloud #AISingapore

text.text:
Anthropic dropped /loop an hour ago and I have a few ideas on how to use it. 

It’s a scheduled task runner built into Claude Code. Write the instruction once, set the cadence, and Claude handles it in the background while you get on with your day.

Their own example: “/loop every morning use the Slack MCP to give me a summary of top posts I was tagged in”

You could also add gmail, calendar and telegram access to this too with the basic connectors in Claude. 

That’s your morning briefing. Done before you’ve opened your laptop.

For founders and builders the use cases are obvious. Summarise overnight messages. 

Surface what matters. Flag anything urgent. All without you lifting a finger. Help you prioritise your day an schedule. 

The AI tools that just sit there waiting for you to ask them something are already starting to feel old.

This is what the next phase looks like
